name: doge_alignment
short: D&D alignment chart for your server, drawn with members' avatars
description: A 3x3 D&D alignment chart per server, drawn as one picture or as a gallery of nine, with members' avatars. Slash and text commands (`alignment`), alignment admins, YAML export and import. Needs ImageMagick (libmagickwand) on the bot's host for pictures; without it the chart is shown as text.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores your alignment, display name and avatar URL for each server's chart, and whether you are an alignment admin there. `alignment remove` takes you off a chart; Red's data deletion removes you everywhere.
